svg.text: About
I build assistants that answer questions from a company's real data, in writing or by voice. Right now I'm on
a two-person team building one for hotel managers: they ask something like "how's my occupancy this month?"
and get the answer from live data.
The model never touches the database directly. It can only call a fixed set of tools, and every hotel sees
only its own data. That is the part I care about most, and the part I test the most.
Projects
Hotel assistant (client project, private)
Written and voice assistant for hotel managers. I built the voice side, the operations setup and the sign-in
system, and I helped choose the AI provider after comparing cost and quality. It started as a prototype and
now runs live.
Crypto forecasting system (personal project)
Combines three kinds of models, including one that reads news sentiment, to forecast prices. A local language
model explains the market in plain words, and a web dashboard shows everything.
Tools
Python, C# / .NET, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git.
Claude API, Azure AI Foundry, ElevenLabs, LangChain, Hugging Face.
Also
I'm the president of the Engineering Thinking Community at my university: a 12-person board and about 500
members, running coding competitions, robotics contests and technical trips. I'm also working through the
Microsoft Learn path for Azure and ASP.NET Core.
